label: Karoo Sentinel
description: Open-source anti-theft security and live GPS tracking extension for Hammerhead Karoo. Detects unauthorized bike motion, sounds a hardware beeper siren, and sends real-time Telegram location alerts.
releaseNotes: v0.0.8: New official branding, native launcher icon, multi-language support, Di2/SRAM AXS Bonus Buttons, and automated release pipeline.
